VXfZNOVw_70.title: The Lake That Can Turn Animals Into Stone
VXfZNOVw_70.transcript: Have you ever heard of a lake that can turn animals into stone? There is a strange lake in Tanzania, Africa. It is called Lake Natron. The lake has a very special look. Sometimes the water can look red or orange. But there is something even more interesting. The lake can be dangerous for some animals. The water is very salty. It is also very alkaline. This means the water is not safe for many animals. The lake can also be very hot. Some animals cannot live in this water. But flamingos are different. Thousands of flamingos come to Lake Natron. The lake is an important place for them. They can live near the lake and find food there. But what happens when an animal dies near the lake? This is where the story becomes strange. The water has many minerals. When a dead animal stays in the water for some time, these minerals can cover its body. The body can become hard. It can look like stone. That is why people sometimes say this lake turns animals into stone. But the lake does not really turn a living animal into stone. That is an important fact. The animal is already dead. Then the minerals can cover and harden parts of its body. The animal can look like a statue. Photographers have taken pictures of these strange animals. The pictures look scary. They look like animals from a strange movie. But there is a simple reason for this. It is the special water. Lake Natron is also a beautiful place. The red color can come from tiny living things in the water. The lake is surrounded by dry land and mountains. It looks very different from many other lakes. So, Lake Natron is both beautiful and dangerous. It can look like a place from a mystery story. But, science gives us a simple answer. The lake does not have magic powers. It does not really turn animals into stone. Its salty water and minerals can make dead animals hard and dry. Nature can create some very strange sights. And Lake Natron is one of them.

60P6qFid0ac.title: The Island With Hundreds of Statues
60P6qFid0ac.transcript: Have you ever seen a giant stone statue? Imagine seeing hundreds of them on one island. The island is called Easter Island. It is in the Pacific Ocean. It is very far from many other places. The island is famous for its huge stone statues. The statues are called Moai. There are almost a thousand Moai on the island. Some are very tall. Some are more than 10 m high. Most of the statues are made from volcanic rock. The people who made them lived on the island many years ago. They did not have modern machines. They did not have trucks. They did not have cranes. So, how did they move these huge statues? This is one of the great questions about Easter Island. The people used simple tools. They used wood, ropes, and other materials. Scientists have tested different ideas. Some tests show that people may have moved the statues in a standing position. They used ropes. They moved the statue from side to side. It looked a little like the statue was walking. This may have helped them move the heavy stone. But, why did they make the statues? The exact answer is not completely clear. Many people think the statues showed important people or family leaders. The statues may also have had a connection with religion. Many Moai face the land. They do not usually face the sea. Some statues stand near old villages. Others are still in the place where people made them. There is another strange thing. Some statues were never finished. Some are still in the side of a volcano. People stopped working on them. We don't know exactly why. Today, Easter Island is a special place. People come from around the world to see the Moai. The statues are hundreds of years old. They show us the skill of the people who made them, but they also leave us with many questions. Who were the people who made them? Why did they build so many? And how did they move such heavy stones? We know some answers, but we do not know everything. That is what makes the moai so interesting. They are not just big stone statues. They are a mystery from the past.

3F-FIf-JsPQ.title: The Island That Appears and Disappears
3F-FIf-JsPQ.transcript: Have you ever heard of an island that appears from the sea? It sounds like a story, but this can really happen. There is a famous example near Sicily, Italy. The island is called Ferdinandea. It is also known by another name, Graham Island. The island has a very strange story. In 1831, people saw something new in the sea. The sea was bubbling. There was smoke. There were rocks in the water. Then, land started to rise from the sea. A new island was growing. People were very surprised. The island became bigger and bigger. It had black rocks. It had a small mountain. People came to see it. Some people even went onto the new island. But the island did not stay for long. The sea slowly began to cover it. The waves hit the soft rock. The island smaller. Then, it disappeared under the water. Today, you cannot see Ferdinandea above the sea. But the island is still there, under the water. So, why did this happen? The answer is a volcano. Deep under the sea, there are volcanoes. A volcano can send hot rock and gas up from inside the earth. When this happens under the sea, the rock can build up. More and more rock can rise above the water. This can create a new island. But there is a problem. The new rock may be soft. Waves can break it. The sea can slowly take the island away. This [snorts] is what happened to Ferdinandea. The island appeared. People saw it. Then, the sea took it back. But the story does not end there. Scientists still watch this area. There is still volcanic activity under the sea. A new island could appear there again one day. Maybe it will stay for a long time. Maybe it will disappear again. The ocean can change the shape of our planet. Sometimes it can even create new land. So, if you see an island one day and it is gone later, do not think you are dreaming. The island may really have disappeared. Or perhaps it is simply waiting under the sea.

yvFTUacEAmg.title: The Ship Found With No People
yvFTUacEAmg.transcript: Have you ever heard of a ship with no people? It sounds like a scary story. But this really happened. In 1872, a ship was found in the Atlantic Ocean. The ship was called Mary Celeste. It was sailing from New York to Italy. There were people on the ship. There was a captain. There was his family. There were also sailors. The ship carried barrels of alcohol. Everything seemed normal. Then something strange happened. Another ship found the Mary Celeste in the ocean. The ship was still moving. But there was no one on it. Not one person. The captain was gone. The sailors were gone. The captain's family was gone. The ship was not badly damaged. There was food on the ship. There was water. The sailors' clothes were still there. The ship was also carrying its cargo. So what happened? Where did everyone go? This became a big mystery. People had many ideas. Some people thought there was a big storm. Maybe the people left the ship because they were afraid. Some people thought there was a problem with the alcohol. The barrels were not all in good condition. Some people thought the people left the ship for safety. But there was a problem. The small boat from the ship was missing. This was an important clue. Maybe the captain and the others got into the small boat. Maybe they planned to come back. But they never came back. No one knows exactly what happened to them. The Mary Celeste continued its journey with no people. Later, other people took the ship to a safe place. The ship became famous. People started telling many stories about it. Some stories talked about pirates. Some stories talked about sea monsters. Some stories even talked about ghosts. But there was no clear proof for these stories. The real answer is still unknown. Today, the Mary Celeste is one of the most famous ship mysteries in history. A ship was found in the middle of the ocean. The ship was there, the people were not. And after more than 150 years, we still do not know exactly why.

DZNDvEXtwX0.title: What If You Lived a Day on Mars?
DZNDvEXtwX0.transcript: Imagine you wake up on Mars. You open your eyes. You look outside. The sky looks different. You are not on Earth anymore. You are on Mars. Mars is a planet. It is called the red planet because its ground looks red. You step outside your small space home. But you cannot breathe the air. Mars has air, but it is not safe for humans. So, you need a spacesuit. Your suit gives you air. It also protects your body from the cold. Mars is very cold. The temperature can become much lower than on Earth. You start walking. But walking feels strange. Mars has less gravity than Earth. Your body feels lighter. You can jump higher than you can on Earth. You walk slowly across the red ground. You see rocks and dust. You see a very large mountain. Mars has the biggest volcano in our solar system. It is called Olympus Mons. You also see a large empty area. There are no trees. There are no rivers. There are no cities. There are no birds or animals. is a very quiet place. you cannot sit outside and eat. You need to go back inside your space home. Your food comes from Earth. You also need water. Water is very important on Mars. Scientists have found ice on Mars, but people cannot simply drink it. They need special equipment to get and clean the water. Later, you look at the sky. You can see the sun, but it looks smaller than it does from Earth. The sky can also look pink or orange because of the dust in the air. Then night comes. The temperature drops. The sky becomes dark. You look up. You can see stars. You think about Earth. Mars is beautiful, but it is also a very difficult place to live. You need air. You need water. You need food. You need a safe home. So, would you like to spend one day on Mars? Or would you rather stay on Earth?

5Hk0COmcxRM.title: Why Did Ancient Egyptians Build Pyramids?
5Hk0COmcxRM.transcript: Have you ever seen a pyramid? The pyramids in Egypt are very old. They are thousands of years old. But, why did people build them? The answer is connected to the kings of ancient Egypt. The kings were called pharaohs. The ancient Egyptians believed in life after death. They believed that life did not end when a person died. They believed that the pharaoh could live again in another world. So, they built large tombs for their kings. A tomb is a place where a dead person is buried. The pyramid was a very large tomb. Inside the pyramid, there was a special place for the king. The Egyptians also put important things in the tomb. There could be food, clothes, jewelry, and other useful things. They believed the king could need these things after death. The Great Pyramid is the most famous pyramid in Egypt. It is at Giza. It was built for pharaoh Khufu. The pyramid is huge. It was made from millions of large stones. Some stones were very heavy. So, how did the Egyptians move them? They did not have modern machines. They used people, simple tools, wood, ropes, and ramps. Workers moved the stones slowly. They placed the stones one by one. It took many years to build a large pyramid. Many people worked on the project. Some workers cut the stones. Some moved the stones. Others built the pyramid. The pyramids were not only buildings. They showed the power of the pharaoh. They also showed the skills of the ancient Egyptians. Today, people still visit the pyramids. We can see these huge buildings after thousands of years. But, one question still interests many people. How did people build something so large without modern machines? The pyramids give us a look into the world of ancient Egypt. They show us what people could do thousands of years ago.

KdWTEpxpPQM.title: The Door in the Mountain
KdWTEpxpPQM.transcript: Have you ever seen a door in a mountain? Imagine walking through a forest. You see trees, rocks, and green plants. Then you see something strange. There is a door in the side of a mountain. But where does it go? There are many strange doors around the world. Some doors are very old. Some are inside caves. Some are high on mountains. People often ask the same question, who made the door and why is it there? One famous example is in the mountains of China. There are old stone doors in some mountain areas. Some doors lead to caves. People used caves for many reasons. They used them to live. They used them to store food. Some people used caves as safe places. Caves can protect people from rain and strong wind. They can also keep food cool. But some doors are harder to explain. They are high on a mountain. There may be no house near them. There may be no road. There may be only rocks and trees. This makes the door look mysterious. But there is an important thing to remember. A strange door does not always have a strange story. Sometimes people built it many years ago. Then people left. The door stayed there. Nature grew around it. Trees grew near it. Plants covered the rocks. The old door became hard to see. Today, these places attract visitors. People take photos. They ask questions. Some people create stories about the doors. They imagine secret rooms. They imagine hidden treasure. They even imagine secret tunnels. But we should not believe every story. Sometimes the real answer is simple. It may be an old cave. It may be an old home. It may be a place for storing food. And sometimes we simply do not know. That is what makes old places interesting. They give us questions. And sometimes the questions are more interesting than the answers.

tOET7NUgt6s.title: The Mysterious Sound Under the Ocean
tOET7NUgt6s.transcript: Have you ever heard a strange sound? Imagine this. You are in the middle of the ocean. The sea is calm. There are no boats near you. Then, you hear a very loud sound. Where did it come from? In 1997, scientists heard a very strange sound in the Pacific Ocean. They called the sound bloop. The sound was very loud. Scientists heard it with special machines. The machines were under the sea. The sound traveled a very long way. People wanted to know the answer. What made the sound? Was it a huge animal? Was it a sea monster? Was it something from deep inside the earth? Many people had different ideas. The sound was much louder than the sounds of many sea animals. So, the story became very popular. People started talking about a giant animal in the ocean. Some people even talked about sea monsters. But, scientists looked at the sound carefully. They found a more simple answer. The sound was probably from ice. Large pieces of ice can break in the ocean. They can make very loud sounds. These sounds can travel through the water for a very long distance. So, there was probably no giant sea monster. There was no secret animal. It was most likely ice. But, the story is still interesting. The ocean is a very strange place. We know a lot about the ocean, but we still do not know everything. There are deep places that are very hard to reach. There are animals that we have never seen. There are sounds that we do not hear with our ears. So, the next time you hear a strange sound, remember the bloop. Sometimes, the answer is not a monster. Sometimes, the answer is much simpler.

YZRZEIbvf70.title: The Village Everyone Left
YZRZEIbvf70.transcript: Have you ever seen a village with no people? There is a village like this in China. It is called Hoouan. Hotoan is on Shen Shan Island. [music] The island is near Shanghai. Many years ago, Hotoan was a small fishing village. Hundreds of people lived there. There were many houses. People worked near the sea. [music] They caught fish. They sold fish. Children went to school. People lived a simple life. But life in the village became difficult. Fishing became harder. There were not many jobs. The village was also far from the mainland. [music] People needed to travel to get food and other things. The journey was not easy. Education was also a problem. So people started to leave the village. Some families left first, then more families left. Year after year, [music] more people moved away. Soon the village was almost empty. Today, many of the old houses are still there, but very few people live there. Then something beautiful happened. Nature [music] started to take over. Green plants grew on the houses. Vines covered the walls. Plants grew over doors and windows. Some houses are now almost completely [music] green. The old village looks like a green forest. You can still see the old houses. You can still see the old streets. These places tell us about the people who lived there. Hoan is now famous. [music] Many visitors go there. They take photos of the green houses. The village is quiet now. There are no busy streets. There are no children playing outside. There are no fishing boats in the village. People left. Nature came back. Today, Hoouan looks like a village from a story. It is beautiful, but it is also a little strange. A village once full of life is now [music] almost silent.
